```sql
SELECT
  strftime('%Y-%m', order_items.ordered_at) AS month,
  SUM(order_items.product_price) AS revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_items.is_drink_item THEN order_items.product_price ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(order_items.product_price), 0) AS drink_revenue_pct
FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" AS order_items
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', order_items.ordered_at)
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 500
```
